name: lingora-web
description: Learner boundary and web application for Lingora.

scripts.build: npm --prefix .. run db:product:generate -w lingora-admin && node scripts/prepare-prisma-runtime.mjs && next build
scripts.test:feature: node --experimental-strip-types --experimental-test-module-mocks --import ./tests/feature/harness/server-only.mjs --test tests/feature/auth.test.mjs tests/feature/context.test.mjs tests/feature/login-flow.test.mjs tests/feature/review-regressions.test.mjs tests/feature/session-transport.test.mjs tests/feature/prisma-runtime.test.mjs tests/feature/lessons.test.mjs tests/feature/optional-lesson-gating.test.mjs tests/feature/lesson-title.test.mjs tests/feature/lesson-review-regressions.test.mjs tests/feature/practice.test.mjs tests/feature/practice-review-regressions.test.mjs tests/feature/auth-registration.test.mjs tests/feature/confirmation-transport.test.mjs tests/feature/confirmation-cross-device.test.mjs tests/feature/srs.test.mjs tests/feature/srs-scheduler-policy-b.test.mjs tests/feature/srs-writing-scheduler.test.mjs tests/feature/srs-sessions-routes.test.mjs tests/feature/onboarding-recommendation.test.mjs tests/feature/home-path.test.mjs tests/feature/home-timezone-semantics.test.mjs tests/feature/gamification.test.mjs tests/feature/character-learner.test.mjs tests/feature/character-strokes-route.test.mjs tests/feature/writing-sessions-route.test.mjs tests/feature/writing-attempts-route.test.mjs tests/feature/profile.test.mjs tests/feature/profile-route.test.mjs tests/feature/profile-home.test.mjs
scripts.test:components: node --experimental-test-module-mocks --import ./tests/feature/harness/server-only.mjs tests/feature/isolated-components.test.mjs && node --experimental-test-module-mocks --import ./tests/feature/harness/server-only.mjs tests/feature/learner-shell-components.test.mjs && node --experimental-test-module-mocks --import ./tests/feature/harness/server-only.mjs tests/feature/production-pages.test.mjs && node --experimental-test-module-mocks --import ./tests/feature/harness/server-only.mjs tests/feature/lesson-pages.test.mjs && node --experimental-test-module-mocks --import ./tests/feature/harness/server-only.mjs tests/feature/practice-components.test.mjs && node --experimental-test-module-mocks --import ./tests/feature/harness/server-only.mjs tests/feature/review-components.test.mjs && node --experimental-test-module-mocks --import ./tests/feature/harness/server-only.mjs tests/feature/writing-practice-components.test.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types tests/feature/register-components.test.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types tests/feature/onboarding-components.test.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types tests/feature/confirmation-verify-components.test.mjs
scripts.test:all: npm run build && npm run test:feature && npm run test:components && npm run test:landing
